metadata.title: Secure Collaboration Relying System SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan template for systems that embed, integrate with, or depend on Secure Collaboration services.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A system or service that relies on Secure Collaboration platforms for messaging, conferencing, file sharing, or workspace functionality without implementing collaboration trust controls directly.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on the Secure Collaboration Platform SSPP for collaboration trust, governance, and lifecycle controls.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Where external or federated collaborators are involved, this system relies on the External Collaboration SSPP constraints.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system consumes identity, attribution, and delegation services from Secure Identity.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on Secure Network for transport protection, segmentation, and monitoring.

props.name: collaboration-consumption-model
props.remarks: Collaboration functionality is consumed as a governed service and is not re-implemented locally within the relying system.

props.name: trust-boundary
props.remarks: Identity attribution, membership enforcement, and observability occur in the Secure Collaboration platform, not in the relying system.

props.name: data-handling-responsibility
props.remarks: The relying system remains responsible for classifying and governing its own data, even when collaboration services are used.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Relying systems participate in collaboration workflows while preserving defined trust boundaries.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: The relying system inherits collaboration-related controls from Secure Collaboration while implementing application-specific governance.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP documents reliance on Secure Collaboration services for messaging, conferencing, file sharing, and workspace functionality.

components.title: Collaboration-Reliant Application Component
components.description: Logical representation of an application or service that embeds or integrates collaboration capabilities.

roles.title: System Owner
roles.remarks: Defines acceptable collaboration use and data sensitivity for the relying system.

roles.title: Collaboration Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Ensures correct inheritance and use of Secure Collaboration services.

control-implementation.remarks: All collaboration security controls are inherited from Secure Collaboration, Secure Identity, and Secure Network SSPPs. This SSPP documents reliance and boundary conditions only.
